title: Input cells after dropping a prefix
statement: Let $z$ and $y$ be Boolean words, let $\ell$ be a natural number, and suppose deleting the first $\ell$ symbols of $z$ gives $y$. For every nonzero index $i$, the symbol read at index $i$ in $y$ equals the symbol read at index $\ell+i$ in $z$, with indices outside a word yielding no symbol.
hypotheses_covered: The equality $z$ with its first $\ell$ symbols dropped equals $y$
